none: PAS CAM-CF9C50: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Nummus of The House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS ; D/ CONST[...] S MAX AVG

A copper-alloy Nummus of Constantine I (AD 306-37), dating toAD 332-3 (Reece Period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows Two soldiers and two standards. RIC VII, p. 216, no. 537. Obverse shows Diademed head right. Obverse legend reads CONST[...] S MAX AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //TR•P. Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.6g, diameter is 15.66mm
